name: Itzel B.
title: Soft, Hydrating Glow Pads
body: The pads are soft, gentle, and don’t irritate my skin at all. They feel super hydrating and leave my skin looking smooth and naturally glowy. They’re great for when my skin feels dry or dull, they make it look more fresh and plump right away. The formula isn’t heavy, so it feels light and comfortable. Really nice and easy to use, I’d buy them again
